averageHint: Average divides by filled values, including zero. Empty and cleared values are excluded.
scopeHint: Each task counts once, including linked tasks. Children use their own field values. Assignee groups use the primary assignee only. Linked tasks without these project fields remain missing. Reports support up to 5,000 tasks.
staleDraft: This report changed elsewhere. Your draft keeps its original revision. Discard changes to load the current definition.
invalid: Check the report name, selected fields and date range. Choose two different duration fields for comparison.
captureHint: Captures the complete filtered scope and field versions shown by this calculation. Missing original values stay unknown. Later edits never rewrite this snapshot.
selectHint: Choose a saved report to see its current full-scope results.
noReports: No saved reports yet. Create one using your columns, or preview the Plan and fact template.
templatePreview: Creates two new ordinary duration columns and one saved comparison in {{project}}. Existing columns are not reused. Names must be unique across active and archived columns. No week, hours or initial snapshot is created.
comparison: Current plan vs current actual · paired tasks
initialComparison: Original plan vs current actual · retained paired tasks

reason.missing_plan: No complete pair: original or current plan is missing.
reason.missing_fact: No complete pair: actual is missing.
reason.zero_plan: The paired plan is zero. A ratio is not available.

paired: {{paired}} paired of {{eligible}} eligible tasks. Both comparison sums use these same complete pairs.
authoritative: Server totals cover all {{count}} canonical tasks, across every detail page.
cohorts: {{initial}} originally included · {{retained}} retained · {{added}} added · {{removed}} removed from scope
snapshotHint: Added tasks are excluded from original-plan comparison. Removed tasks are counted separately. An absent original stays unknown.
aggregateHint: Shared project totals, calculated by the server over the full supported filtered scope. Collapse and pagination do not change them.
noAggregates: Choose numeric or duration columns to show full-scope totals.
unsupportedFilters: Totals are unavailable for this search, participant, individual status or archived filter. Clear these filters or use Reports to define a supported scope.
aggregateGroup: Full project group · includes linked tasks
updateNeeded: The source changed. Run the report again from the first page.
originalTotalsHint: Immutable values from every task included at capture, including tasks since removed from scope.
unavailableFieldHint: This report references an unavailable or archived field. Edit it to choose an available source; a new field with the same name is a different source.
fullGroupTotals: Full project group totals · includes linked tasks
ownSectionTotals: By each task’s own section · includes linked tasks; independent of the table’s inherited tree
captureCurrentHint: Choose Current values only before capturing a new initial snapshot.
legacyOnly: Available in Legacy time columns; your saved visibility is preserved.
wrongProject: This report belongs to another project. Choose a report from this project.
totalsWaiting: Column totals wait for the current project fields and membership.
templateNameConflict: A column named “{{name}}” already exists, including archived columns. Choose a unique name. To compare existing columns, use New report.
templateDistinctNames: Choose different names for the two new columns.
recordedShareHint: Percentages divide each group’s recorded sum by the full report’s recorded sum. Missing and cleared values are excluded; percentages describe recorded time only.
roundedHint: ≈ marks values rounded to two decimal places. The exact fraction and server value are available in the value tooltip.
temporaryFilters: Temporary view filters · the saved report is unchanged.
quickDateHint: Task dates filter tasks; they do not place recorded time on those workdays. Capacity keeps its own configured date range.
quickInvalid: Choose a valid inclusive date range.

dashboard.deliveryHint: Task status in this project scope. Completion is not a score for product quality.
dashboard.measureLimit: This report already has 12 measures. Replace a measure with a Plan or Actual sum to include that total.
